operator_statement: 2026-10-30: require one valid frame per observation and post-motion decision. Clip projected regions to the image; preserve image identity, gripper footprint checks, movement-stage guards and mechanical reachability. Carry this complete policy into PS migration. Restore the 20-second-target timing values for the currently metal-only execution scope; this does not qualify or enable any additional material. Subsequent operator clarification: open all 26 current recognition classes for supervised single-item trials using their existing paper/plastic/metal mappings; preserve original validation evidence and remaining mechanics/scene guards. Operator explicitly requested admitting every new category on 2026-10-30: use current object geometry rather than the original sample area/aspect/dimension templates; preserve jaw opening, reachability, obstacle, image identity and stop guards. 2026-10-31: operator explicitly requested one complete scene check before the motion sequence and continuous execution of the frozen route, without per-command image or source-file rechecks; preserve live stop, ownership, packet limits, echo/wait checks and post-placement verification.
